notes: The Chrome extension 0.1.1-beta.2 was not published to the Chrome Web Store. This release brings its changes there together with the engine: the redesigned popup and its first-run tour, the download window that closes by itself, and the finishing stages. The Windows installer opens again when started by hand (double-click, or `winget install --interactive`). In 0.1.1-beta.2 it stayed hidden and used a full processor core before showing the Terms page, and a second attempt said Setup was already running until that process was ended in Task Manager. Silent installs with `/ACCEPTTERMS`, which winget uses by default, were not affected. Opening the extension popup, or pressing **Check again** in its Engine settings, no longer makes the engine look for a newer version on the internet. The popup shows the last check; DoRaptim checks only when you ask (`doraptim update`, **Check for updates** in the desktop window) or when you turn on the daily check, as the privacy policy says.
